scope: Only3 authorized host-tool/test files changed; no firmware, SDK, base/retry collector, analyzer/history, build, USB/BLE/serial hardware actions

contract.capability: cpu_owner_v1 exact token; absent/near-match sends no CPUOWNER commands
contract.queries: CPUOWNER?0..6 with fixed reply tag CPUOWNER; before/after only; existing CONFIG identity/revision bracket; no periodic additions
contract.retry: Only these7 indexed readonly commands bypass legacy trailing-question-mark syntax restriction; original single-query Collector, max3 attempts and shared existing phase/total deadlines; setters remain unreplayed
contract.validation: Exact requested role and16hex session matched to opening CONFIG and expected boot identity; full formatter fields, bool/literal enums, U32 task/U64 value bounds; known t1>=t0 and observedAt=t1; available/conflict/reason/unknown/age/stale relationships. Disabled/not-observed/stale/error historical samples preserved but never current CPU0.
contract.raw: Full selected reply retained; exact original bytes stay in raw; processing timestamp and ending RX-chunk host timestamp/offset/length separately retained.
contract.delta: Only pair same session+taskNumber with both samples available/known/non-conflict/non-stale; require non-regressing runUs and ordered non-overlapping t0/t1 brackets. No crossboot arithmetic or unknown-zero substitution. Switch-out accumulated runtime may include ISR and excludes current running slice; not isolated SDK CPU or blocking proof. Collector does not calculate CPU percentages.
contract.compatibility: Existing BLESVC required schema and query behavior unchanged. Its source-schema test accepts additive fields because production v1 added CONF counters.
